xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #6272

plan.title: feat(scope): show which clauses need strict-axis evidence at activation, not after the merge

narratives.Description: scope:complete decides which clauses need deploy, smoke, UAT or observed-behaviour evidence from the brief text alone, but nothing shows that list until completion, after the product PR has merged. This story prints the strict axes each clause will need at scope:activate, scope:promote and xbrief:preflight, using one helper shared with the completion gate. The print is advisory: no new refusal, and the completion gate is unchanged.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`scope:complete` decides which clauses need deploy, smoke, UAT or observed-behaviour evidence (`packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts`, strict axes). That classification is a pure function of the brief text, so it is known when the brief is written. Today nothing shows it until completion, after the product PR has merged. Each surprise then becomes an operator stop.

## Consumer impact

On a consumer project, completion refused 23 of 35 clauses for deploy evidence after the merge. With the list shown at activation, the clause wording or `x-directive/requires` could have been fixed in the brief PR, which is human-reviewed anyway, at no extra operator cost.

## Expected

- `scope:activate`, `scope:promote` and `xbrief:preflight` print the strict axes each clause will need at completion, using the same classifier `scope:complete` uses (one helper, so they cannot drift).
- Advisory only at those verbs: no new refusal. The completion gate is unchanged.

## Acceptance

- Given a brief with a clause that needs deploy evidence, when it is activated, then the output names that clause and the deploy axis.
- A test checks that the activation listing and the completion requirement come from the same function.

Related: the identifier false positive in the strict-axis regex is filed separately.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent writing a brief, I want scope:activate, scope:promote and xbrief:preflight to list the clauses that will need strict-axis evidence, so that I fix the wording or declare x-directive/requires in the reviewed brief PR instead of after the merge.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add one exported helper in packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts that returns, per plan item, the strict axes the completion gate will require; make the completion gate call it.
2. Print its result (clause id and axes, plus a pointer to x-directive/requires) after a successful scope:activate and scope:promote (packages/core/src/scope/main.ts) and xbrief:preflight (packages/runtime/src/vbrief-preflight.ts). Exit codes do not change.
3. Tests: activation output names a deploy-axis clause; the listing and the completion requirement come from the same function; exit codes unchanged.
4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] line. Lands after #6270 (same classifier).

swarm.acceptance_criteria_justification: The ingest admitted every sentence of the issue body, and verify:ac requires each admitted sentence as a clause (#5055), so the brief has one clause and one item per sentence, each bound to acceptance-evidence.ts, its test, or scope/main.test.ts. The issue title is the one confession.
